producer_report.summary: Wrote docs/design/jev-code-health.md (design only): Existing code survey, build plan J1–J5 each marked reuse/extend/new and sized for one producer run, batched-call cost (range $0.000012 to about $0.00002, call counts labeled estimates), five typed questions with state/options/criteria/threshold/effect, shadow period, exit rule, evidence scoring feeding labeled.rs, and fit with 5p65 (assumed), Hestia and the scope guard. Appended D131 (proposed, with alternatives) to docs/decisions.md and added a CHANGELOG entry. decision-links.toml untouched. Full cargo test --locked passes.

checks_run.note: All suites ok, 0 failed (first run's output was too large to read; reran quiet).

criteria_check.criterion: docs/design/jev-code-health.md has an 'Existing code' section listing with file paths and purpose: the POST /v1/evaluate client and FakeJev in crates/athena-core/src/jev.rs, the opt-in live test live_jev_answers_both_question_kinds, and labeled.rs with the `athena score-jev` command; each path exists in the repo.
criteria_check.evidence: Section 2 lists jev.rs (JevClient, request_body, FakeJev), the live test, labeled.rs, and score-jev with main.rs, display.rs and tests/labeled.rs; I read jev.rs and labeled.rs and grepped score-jev; the test file was found by Glob.

criteria_check.criterion: Every build-plan item (including J3 and J4) is marked reuse, extend or new against that survey; the plan adds only code-health questions, state builders, thresholds, shadow records and evidence scoring, and rebuilds no client, fake or scorer.
criteria_check.evidence: Section 3 table: J1 new, J2 new, J3 extend, J4 extend, J5 extend; none adds a client, fake or scorer, and the text says so.

criteria_check.criterion: Batching (several questions per call, citing jev.rs request_body) and cost per landing use batched calls, with the per-call price given as a range ($0.000012 to about $0.00002, citing defaults-loop.md) and call counts labeled estimates.
criteria_check.evidence: Section 4 cites jev::request_body taking a BTreeMap of questions, gives the range citing defaults-loop.md lines 259 and 667, and labels the per-landing table as estimates.

criteria_check.criterion: For each of at least five questions (one-thing-or-several, added coupling, module placement, god-object drift, duplicated logic) the doc gives state (bounded excerpt and context), options, criteria, numeric confidence threshold, and effect (status finding, structural-pass request via 20261026-042558-5p65, or nothing).
criteria_check.evidence: Sections 5.2 to 5.6 each give State, Options, Criteria, numeric threshold and Effect; 5.1 bounds the excerpt at 24,000 bytes.

criteria_check.criterion: The doc defines the shadow period, its exit rule, and evidence scoring (flagged file later breaks or churns; recommended split lands and reduces churn), how each is measured from landing records, and how it feeds the existing labeled.rs scorer.
criteria_check.evidence: Section 6.1 to 6.4: 4-week floor, break/churn/split labels measured from job and candidate records (fields marked assumed), rows fed to brier/split/report with MIN_TEST_CASES, exit rule list.

criteria_check.criterion: The doc explains fit with deterministic code-health measures (those from 20261026-042558-5p65 marked as assumed since the request is not in the repo), Hestia (20261025-033743-npr5) and the scope guard.
criteria_check.evidence: Section 1 marks 5p65 assumed; section 7 covers 5p65, Hestia (npr5, hestia.md, D129) and the scope guard (scope-guard.md, D127).

criteria_check.criterion: docs/decisions.md gains one entry marked proposed with alternatives; build-plan jobs are each stated as sized for one producer run with files and a test or demonstration; CHANGELOG.md has an entry; no other files change except docs/decision-links.toml if required.
criteria_check.evidence: D131 appended at the end, status proposed, alternatives (a) to (e); section 3 states one-producer-run sizing with files and test per job; CHANGELOG entry added under Unreleased Changed; decision-links.toml not changed and tests pass.

criteria_check.criterion: Run cargo test from the repository root: all tests pass, including any test checking decisions.md format or decision links.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran `cargo test --locked --quiet` from the root: every suite reported ok with 0 failed (a few ignored by design).

open_issues: Landing-record field names for changed files were not verified (marked assumed in section 6.2); J4 must confirm them.
The doc names a new record kind athena.code-health-shadow/1 without checking schema-registration conventions in records.rs; J3 must follow them.
The 24,000-byte state cap, all thresholds, the 30-day windows and the landings-per-week figures are unmeasured estimates, labeled as such.
mistakes: The first full cargo test output was too large to read and could not be searched, so I reran with --quiet; this cost a second suite run, against the one-run guidance.
learnings: Landing records are not one kind: athena.job, candidate, verification and outcome records exist in crates/athena-data/src/records.rs, but I did not read their fields, so the doc marks the changed-file fields as assumed.
labeled.rs rows are failure-class rows built from introspections and class labels only; code-health rows need a second source.
CHANGELOG.md has twelve '### Changed' headings, so an edit needs the '## [Unreleased]' line for context.
decisions.md ended at D130, so D131 appended without shifting any line that decision-links.toml keys on.
desires: Permission to read large tool-output files so a long test log could be searched instead of rerun.
